facts.text: Gold Kapton MLI Equipment Enclosure was deployed at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit during Kepler Space Telescope in 2009.
Multi-layer insulation (MLI) blankets composed of embossed aluminized and gold Kapton foil shielding avionics, star trackers, and hydrazine fuel tanks.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Operated down to the final drop of hydrazine propellant on 30 October 2018, having expended every gram of fuel searching for worlds.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit.
A monument to human curiosity, now drifting quietly in an Earth-trailing orbit forever.
